name: Hunter armor

Lights on eyes, caster lens, cloak.

netted mesh chest with lattice, pectoral, sternum and abdomen plates, collar ring
back plate with spine beads and power cells

cloak shimmer inlays on chest, gauntlets, shoulders, back and brow

summary: Human-scale trophy hunter armor kit: mandible battle mask, shoulder plasma caster, wrist blades, netted mesh chest and cloak shimmer inlays.
